label: Italian Winter
aesthetic: Neapolitan winter: cashmere/merino knit, grey or brown wool trousers, suede loafers, overcoat or shearling.
signature_pieces: fine merino/cashmere crew, turtleneck, knit polo
grey flannel / brown wool / cord trouser
brown suede loafer (tassel/penny), dark leather loafer

min_signals.why: at least 3 of: fine knit top, wool/cord trouser, suede loafer, winter outer

banned.why: No summer, country, street or work tops.
No denim, linen or pale trousers.
Cream cable-knit (125 of 601 saved looks, chunky, cream/navy/green) is not a Neapolitan fine knit; banned outright here, not just capped.

pairing_rules.why: A coat proxy is the IW signature (Joe has no overcoat).
Shearling over cable is too bulky.
A shirt only under a jacket.
Pinstripe trousers read suit-orphan unless under a blazer.

weekday.modifier: Knit + grey wool + suede loafer + blazer/shearling

out.modifier: Dark knit + wool/cord + black woven or suede loafer + blazer

card_note: Neapolitan winter: fine knit, grey wool or cords, suede loafers, coat.
gap_note: No overcoat or labelled merino/cashmere: using shearling/suede/blazer over knits.

must_differ.polo: IW requires a jacket in fall/winter and bans sneakers, piqué polos and OCBD without a jacket.
must_differ.purple: IW prefers dark wool + navy blazer/shearling; Purple prefers soft blazers + lighter trousers.
must_differ.sweetstable: IW never uses boots, fair isle or plaid.

scoring.empty_state: In summer, hide the row. If 0 looks pass, show the closest look missing only the jacket, plus the gap note 'No overcoat'.

gaps: No plate labelled merino, cashmere or turtleneck (materials say 'knit'/'wool', fiber unknown).
No flannel trouser labelled as such (grey/light grey pleated and maroon/brown wool stand in).

weekend/summer.note: No overcoat or labelled merino/cashmere: using shearling/suede/blazer over knits.

current_code_scoring: houses.ts italianWinter: required tokens (knit + wool/cord + suede loafer + blazer/shearling), houseGapNote 'No overcoat — shearling or blazer over merino'. lookFitsOccasion HAS an italianWinter Weekday branch.
